title: The Null Energy Condition through the Lens of Optimal Transport: Smooth and Non-Smooth Spacetimes
summary: We survey recent developments on the null energy condition (NEC) from the perspective of optimal transport, with emphasis on non-smooth Lorentzian geometry. After recalling the role of classical energy conditions in general relativity, we discuss the relation between Ricci curvature and entropy convexity in optimal transport. The main focus is the authors' optimal-transport characterization of the NEC.
